row.notes: byte: tyre allocation rule mode; 0 = check 0x142e88730 (tags 1..4 practice, 5..9 qualifying, 15..17 races, tag 0 any), 1 = the inline rules of 0x142e88630, other = every set usable

verify.notes: V0970 0x142e8863f movzx r8d, byte [0x146080694]: == 1 goes to the inline rules at 0x142e8865b, any other non-zero value jumps to 0x142e88665 and returns 1, and 0 calls 0x142e88730. The picker body 0x14f3da1d0 dispatches the same way (other values rank every set). 0x142e88730: tag 0 is accepted anywhere; sessions 1..4 take tags 1..4; 5..9 take 5..9 (except tag 7 with bit2 'mandatory' when the session is <= 6); 15..17 take tags 5..14, the computed race tag, and 15..17 under a bit2 rule. So the parenthetical is a summary, not the full rule. 0x140bcc190 reads it (when the active byte is set) to choose how many practice sets to hand back. The byte is +0x0c of the rules block that 0x14f3fcb70 copies (the qword at 0x146080690). sigcheck: 1 hit
